scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @futsal/sim && npm run test -w @futsal/server && npm run test -w @futsal/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @futsal/shared && npm run typecheck -w @futsal/sim && npm run typecheck -w @futsal/server && npm run typecheck -w @futsal/web
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
